subject.title: bundle-mcp: remote streamable-http server connects but tools never materialize for a Pi agent (2026.5.7)

question: Should this issue stay open until the exact bearer-authenticated streamable-http Pi-agent setup is retried on current main/latest release, or is the existing current-main source and test coverage enough to close it?
rationale: Source inspection shows the intended path exists, but the issue's real failure depends on a remote authenticated streamable-http server and final policy context that were not reproduced in this read-only review.

options.title: Keep Open For Current-Version Proof
options.body: Leave this issue open and ask for a current-main or v2026.6.11 retry with MCP probe, effective policy diagnostics, and the compiled context/tool list.

options.title: Close As Covered By Current MCP Path
options.body: Close only if a maintainer accepts the source/test coverage as sufficient proof that the reported v2026.5.7 behavior is fixed.

options.title: Fold Into ToolFilter Work
options.body: Treat the issue as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98193 only if the reporter confirms a per-server `toolFilter` was present in the failing config.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Current-Version Proof
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and ask for a current-main or v2026.6.11 retry with MCP probe, effective policy diagnostics, and the compiled context/tool list.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current MCP runtime/transport seams and streamable-http naming path from git history.
